notes: The ASV margin ('satisfiest every living thing with favor') was read and set aside; the printed text governs under rule 38, so לְ takes the 'of' the recasting writes for it and רָצוֹן is the English object with its supplied determiner under rule 15.
'living thing' heads on 'living' under rule 31, the generic noun being the ASV's completion of the substantival adjective.
